title: Skin Care for Mangalore Weather: A Light Routine for Coastal Humidity and Heavy Monsoon
ex: Humid almost all year, a very heavy monsoon and no real winter: a simple skin care routine for people living in Mangaluru and coastal Karnataka.
rt: Skin Care for Mangalore Weather: Coastal Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Mangalore weather: light layers for coastal humidity, heavy-monsoon hygiene, sunscreen on rainy days, beach and festival tips, kept simple.
quick: Mangalore is hot and humid almost all year and gets a very heavy southwest monsoon from June to September. A gentle face wash, a thin moisturiser, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and a small amount of night cream suit most people, with a little more moisture in December and January.
facts: Mangaluru has a hot, humid coastal climate
The southwest monsoon from June to September is very heavy
There is no real cold season; December and January are only slightly drier
Strong sun returns quickly after the rains
